about: Shared rules fixtures for clients that reimplement Ember Core's day rules without a server (web/src/lib/local/). Generated from Core by tests/Ember.Tests/RulesFixtureTests.cs, which fails when Core and this file disagree; after a deliberate rule change, regenerate the expected values with EMBER_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 dotnet test --filter RulesFixtureTests (inputs are kept, expected is rewritten). Each case: name, today (the user's local day), from (first day of the expected days and dayStats ranges, which run through today), timezone, graceDaysPerWeek, lowDays (the user's low days), habits, routines and expected. A habit: id, frequency (daily|weekly|weekdays), weeklyTarget (weekly only, else null), days (weekdays only: mon..sun, else null), timesPerDay, startDate (the habit was created at 12:00 UTC on this day), pausedFrom and pausedUntil (inclusive pause range; pausedFrom null with pausedUntil set pauses every day up to pausedUntil), routineId, and logs { date, count, completed } where completed is the stored done flag: set when count reached timesPerDay at the time of the check-in, so a day stays done after the target rises (only today is recomputed on a target change, and past days whose count reaches a lowered target become done). A routine: id and habitIds in routine order. expected.days[habitId]: one { date, state, completed, count } per day from..today; state is the first that applies of beforestart, paused, lowday, done, partial, offday, pending (today or yesterday), notdone; completed is the log's flag (null without a log or when partial). expected.stats[habitId]: exactly the API Habit DTO stats { streak, graceUsed, bestStreak, last7, week }: weekly habits have streak, graceUsed and bestStreak null and week { done, target }; other habits week null. expected.dayStats: one { date, scheduled, done, partial, showedUp } per day from..today. expected.routinePending[routineId]: ids of the member habits a routine reminder today lists (pending or partial today), in routine order. Core also treats an unlogged day on its timezone switchover date (2026-10-11) as protected in streaks; the fixtures use 2027 dates and avoid it.

cases.name: daily streak with one grace day used
daily streak ends when grace is exhausted
daily streak without grace breaks on the first closed gap
open days (today and yesterday) stay pending and never break
low day protects a streak without grace
pause range is protected and paused through today
weekdays step over offdays, a done offday extends the streak, an undone offday is rest
times per day: partial days open and closed
a day done when checked in stays done after the target rose
a lowered target: counts above it and days that reached it are done
weekly progress counts this week's done days
routine pending lists exclude done, offday and paused habits
routine pending on a low day lists nothing
